title: Typical or forced: couplings and field contracts of the made field

key_results.statement: Class C, test body: effective level-$k$ blocks $B_{x,k}=M_k\sigma_3+\gamma N(x)W_k+E_\varphi$, $W_k=f_k\sigma_3+g_k\mathbb 1_2+h_{1,k}\sigma_1+h_{2,k}\sigma_2$, hopping $\tau_{x,x+1;k}=\tau(1+\gamma b_k\bar N_x)$.
R3 holds at every place in every field state iff $(f,g,h_1,h_2)=(\alpha,\beta,\eta_1,\eta_2)(m\mathbb 1_N+D)$ with $b$ free; then $\Gamma(x)=\gamma\Delta N(x)W_*$.

At first order in the gradients and exact in $\gamma N_0$: the start at $p=0$ has velocity $v_{k,\sigma}(0)=-\sigma\tau_k\gamma N_0h_{1,k}/\lvert\mathbf d_k(0)\rvert$ (at rest in every state iff $h_1=0$); for $h_1=0$ the fall is $a_{k,\sigma}(0)=-\tau_k^2(\sigma v_k'+\tilde\mu_k')/\tilde\mu_k$.

R3 at every place plus a fall from rest at $p=0$ that is level-independent on both branches in every field state holds exactly on $\mathcal S_1\cup\mathcal S_1^0$: $\mathcal S_1$: $h_1=0$, $(f,g,h_2)=(\alpha,\beta,\eta_2)(m+D)\neq0$, $b=b_0\mathbb 1_N$; $\mathcal S_1^0$: $f=g=h_1=h_2=0$ (zero fall); the two branches fall alike iff $\beta=0$; coupling (r) lies outside.

In class C of dimension $5N$: $\dim\mathcal S_{\rm R3}=N+4$, $\dim\mathcal S_1=4$ (3 with $\beta=0$), $\dim\mathcal S_1^0=N$, $\dim\mathcal S_2=1$; for $N\ge2$ all are nowhere dense and of measure zero (exceptional), and the language does not select them within class C.

First-order breaking around $P_0\in\mathcal S_1$ with $\eta_2=0$: R3 defect $\gamma\Delta N(x)\delta W_k$ (exact); rest defect $v_{k,\sigma}(0)=-\sigma\tau(\rho_0/\nu_0)\gamma N_0\delta h_{1,k}/M_k$; fall defect through $\delta f_k/M_k$, $\delta g_k/M_k$ at order $\gamma N'$ and $\delta b_k$ at order $\gamma^2N_0N'$; $\delta h_2$ enters the fall only at second order.

Class F, F1, lowest state: $\chi_0(x,y)=\frac{2n}{\lvert X_f\rvert}\sum_q\cos(q\cdot d)S_L(q)$, $S_L(q)=\langle w_0\vert\phi(h(k_0+q)-\epsilon_0)^{-1}\phi\vert w_0\rangle$ for $q\neq0$; made field $N(y)=n\bar\phi-g\chi_0(y,x_s)+O(g^2)$.

$S=\lvert F\rvert^2/(\epsilon_0(k_0+q)-\epsilon_0)+S_{\rm an}$ with analytic $\lvert F\rvert^2$, $S_{\rm an}$, $\lvert F(0)\rvert^2=\bar\phi^2$; if the even part of $S$ is analytic at $q=0$, the made field is short range uniformly in $L$.

eq0$ is long range.

If $\bar\phi=0$: short range in $D=1$; in $D=2,3$ $\chi_0=-2n\sum C_{\mu\nu}\partial_\mu\partial_\nu\mathcal G_A+c_L+O(\lvert d\rvert^{-D-1})$, a $\lvert d\rvert^{-D}$ power law unless $C=cA$ ($C=0$ for $D=3$); short range is confined to the closed set $\bar\phi=0$ with empty interior.

Coulomb-type long range iff $\Phi_x$ carries the density of the conserved number of field objects (gapless band) in the lowest state, $\bar\phi\neq0$, M6-invariantly $\lim_{q\to0}\lvert X_f\rvert N_f^{-1/2}\lvert\langle\varphi_q\vert\Phi_x\vert\varphi_0\rangle\rvert\neq0$; sufficient for short range: a conserved charge $\sum_jZ^{(j)}$ that $\Phi_x$ changes within the lowest sector (Z).

Short-range member of class F: $r=2$, $h=(C_1+2Dt_f)\otimes\mathbb 1_2+\Delta\mathbb 1\otimes\lvert2\rangle\langle2\rvert$, $\phi=\sigma_1$; in $D=1$ $\chi_0=\frac{n}{t_f\sinh\kappa}\cosh\kappa(\frac L2-d)/\sinh\frac{\kappa L}2$, $\cosh\kappa=1+\Delta/(2t_f)$; in every $D$ exponentially bounded uniformly in $L$.

open_issues: Members of class F outside F1 (minimum incommensurate with L, degenerate or quartic minimum, several minimizers) are not treated; a quartic minimum with φ̄ = 0 could be long range even in D = 1.
In D = 2, 3 short range on the set φ̄ = 0, C = cA is decided by higher orders of (8.9), not characterized here; condition (Z) is only sufficient.

Item 1 is derived at the band point p = 0 and first order in the gradients; second-order effects of h1, h2, the band point p = π, and assumption T3 on realizable field profiles are not examined further.
Exceptional and typical refer to the natural parametrizations of classes C and F; the language supplies no measure on descriptions.
